The query is open-ended generative work (constructing a framework/process), and Willet has a documented aversion to exactly this kind of task while Dunlin shows no such preference penalty. Capability scores are effectively tied (within the 2.0-point variance band), so the deciding factor is matching the task to the model that doesn't disfavor open-ended generation—keeping the model working on a task type it's comfortable with.
